fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) corrected from an all-time high in October after triple-digit earnings growth in 2026, but fundamentals are supported by nearly doubling data center revenue.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 data center revenue of $8.55B (97% YoY increase) accounts for 64% of total revenue, with operating margin expanding 9 points from 25% to 34%.
fields.summary_ko.2: With a 2027 CAGR target of 35% or more, the market is undervaluing future earnings growth, and current valuation can be justified.
